{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Pennyrile Energy Corridor''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.

==Location==
The pipeline runs from ANR Pipeline trunk line near Lamasco, Kentucky to Guthrie, Kentucky.
